# 6 bed detached house for sale

> Summerville is one of Blackrock's landmark homes. Dating from c.1807 this beautiful 515sq.m./5540 sq.ft. residence has retained its fine period features and character to create a lovely family home standing on 0.5 acres of mature and secluded gardens and providing light filled views to the mountains and the sea from its upper floors.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 6 bed
- Plocha: 515 m²
- Energetická náročnost: Exempt
- Lokalita: Summerville, 21 Cross Avenue, Blackrock
- Cena: 2 950 000 €
